meta.title: Keepsite Media | Websites for people with other things to do
meta.description: We build your website and run it, so you can run your business. Custom sites for busy business owners, kept working month after month. Packages from $1,200.

hero.headline: Websites for people with other things to do.
hero.sub: We build it. We keep it working. It stays off your list.

problem.heading: You've been meaning to fix your website for a year.
problem.body: The work is good. The business is real. The site is the thing you open at 10pm, look at, and close again. That's not a character flaw. It's a job that shouldn't be yours.

solution.heading: We build it. We keep it useful.

beats.title: We build it.
beats.body: A custom site around what your business does and who you want walking in the door. From Growth up, the whole structure comes from research into what your customers search for.

beats.title: We keep it working.
beats.body: Hosting, maintenance, monitoring, and the small changes that pile up. You send the new photo or the new hours. We put them in.

beats.title: We tell you what's working.
beats.body: A plain-English summary every quarter. What the site did, what we changed, what we'd do next. No dashboard to log into.

solution.pullLine: A website that earns its keep.

packages.heading: Four ways to work with us.
packages.linkLabel: See what's included, and what it costs

pillars.title: Make it useful.
pillars.body: Every site has a job. We find out what yours is, build for that, and leave out the rest.

pillars.title: Keep it simple.
pillars.body: Three decisions, one round of changes at each, and no homework in between.

pillars.title: Show your work.
pillars.body: Clear prices, clear scope, and a summary every quarter you can read in two minutes.

pillars.title: Build for real life.
pillars.body: We run businesses too. We know what it's like to be the only one holding it all together. The site fits around your week, not the other way round.

closing.heading: Keep your business moving.
closing.sub: We'll take care of the website.
